description: This Java source file defines the MapStack class, a specialized collection extending MapContext, which implements a stack of Maps used to represent hierarchical or layered contexts in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for creating and managing shared or independent MapStack instances, with particular handling for 'context' key access.

classes.name: MapStack
classes.description: A specialized stack of Map contexts extending MapContext, providing methods for stack manipulation and context sharing.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new MapStack with an initial context.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new MapStack based on an existing Map or MapStack.

methods.name: standAloneStack
methods.description: Creates a duplicate MapStack sharing the same contexts, used for independent parent and child contexts.

methods.name: standAloneChildStack
methods.description: Creates a duplicate MapStack with an additional empty context pushed, enabling child context operations.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Overrides Map get method to return the MapStack instance itself when the key is 'context'.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Overloaded version with locale parameter, similarly returns self for key 'context'.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Overrides Map put to warn when putting a value with key 'context' that is not self.
